message.content:
Based on my search, I can provide you with comprehensive information about **CFA Institute membership**. Here's what you need to know:

---

## CFA Institute Membership Types

### 1. **Regular Membership**
- **Who it's for:** Investment professionals directly involved in or supporting the investment decision-making process
- **Requirements:**
  - Bachelor's degree or equivalent education/work experience
  - Passing score on Level I CFA Exam (or equivalent)
  - At least **4,000 hours of relevant work experience** completed over a minimum of **36 months**
  - **2 professional references** if one is an active regular member of your local CFA society, OR **3 professional references** if none are active members
- **Benefits:** Voting rights for CFA Institute Board of Governor elections, access to research, professional learning content, member directory, exclusive volunteer opportunities
- **This is a prerequisite for earning the CFA charter**

### 2. **Affiliate Membership**
- **Who it's for:** Investment professionals who don't meet regular membership eligibility requirements
- **Requirements:** Passing score on Level I CFA Exam
- **No work experience required**
- **Benefits:** Access to research, continued professional learning content, member directory, exclusive volunteer opportunities (but **no voting rights**)

---

## CFA Membership Fees (2026)

| Fee Component | Amount (USD) | Notes |
|-------------|-------------|-------|
| **CFA Institute Annual Dues (Regular Member)** | **$299/year** | Required to maintain charterholder status and use CFA designation |
| **Local Society Dues** | $50–$200/year | Varies by region; optional but recommended for networking |
| **CFA Society India Dues** | Collected in INR | Now collected separately in local currency |

### Important Notes on Fees:
- The **$299 annual membership fee** is mandatory to keep your charter active — if you stop paying, you lose the right to use the CFA designation
- You can reactivate membership by paying back dues if it lapses
- **Professional Leave status** is available for members not working full-time in the industry (e.g., career change, family/health matters, unemployment, full-time student, retired) — offers reduced dues

---

## Requirements to Earn the CFA Charter

To become a **CFA charterholder**, you must complete all of the following:

| Requirement | Details |
|------------|---------|
| **Pass all 3 CFA exams** | Levels I, II, and III |
| **Work experience** | 4,000 hours of investment-related work over minimum 36 months |
| **Professional references** | 2-3 references (depending on whether one is a CFA society member) |
| **Sign Ethics pledge** | Commitment to CFA Institute Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct |
| **Apply for Regular Membership** | Both CFA Institute and local society membership |

---

## 2026 CFA Exam Registration Fees (for reference)

| Level | Early Registration | Standard Registration |
|-------|-------------------|----------------------|
| Level I & II | $1,140 | $1,490 |
| Level III | $1,240 | $1,590 |

- **Enrollment fee:** Abolished starting February 2026 (was $350 previously)
- **Rescheduling fee:** $250 per instance

---

## Application Process

1. Visit: https://www.cfainstitute.org/membership/join
2. Complete all sections: Personal Profile, Address, Education, Work Experience, Select Society, References
3. Pay CFA Institute membership dues
4. Pay local society dues separately (e.g., CFA Society India dues in INR)

**Processing time:** CFA Institute review takes up to 10 business days; local society review may take up to 1 month.

---

Sources:
1. https://300hours.com/cfa-exam-cost/
2. https://capstonelearnings.com/cfa-vs-frm-india/
3. https://www.zelleducation.com/blog/cfa-membership-fees/
4. https://cfasocietyindia.org/membership/
5. https://quintedge.com/blog/cfa-course-fee
6. https://300hours.com/cfa-requirements/
